title: Microsoft 365 outage knocks out Outlook, Teams and Copilot in more than 70 countries
what_changed: Removed unverified claim of nearly 130,000 Downdetector Outlook reports at peak; Al Jazeera gives at least 43,000 by about 07:00 GMT on Nov 13 and reports from 74 countries. Cause and duration restated as Microsoft and Yahoo Finance state them.
